title: OWED (blocked-on-slot): the CLIPSeg empty-mask graph defect was never fixed -- it left the board by AUTO-CLOSE during a render drought
evidence: Class (a) of the old render-execution-error entry: job 7563 (2026-09-21 11:16Z) died inside the workflow with 'index is out of bounds for dimension with size 0' at the WAS 'Bounded Image Crop with Mask' node, because an EMPTY CLIPSeg head/hand mask reached it. The probe's fresh-error reporter (24h window) is the right shape for a one-off node crash, but this pass it aged out with 'condition no longer reproduces' purely because ZERO renders ran in the window (last render attempt 07:01Z, refusals_12h=7) -- that is an absence with no interval coverage, not a repair. The DECISION from 09-22 03:5xZ stands and is unchanged: repair the stored graph in place via a rake task of the same shape as pipeline:prompt_safety (snapshot the stored comfy_workflow_json into ops/backups, guard the crop node against a zero-area mask, revert by restoring the column) -- blocked-on-slot, not blocked-on-idea, because the only verification is a render and a bad edit to the 75-node production graph risks the only publish path. CLOSURE CONDITION: the guard edit applied AND verified by a render (same prompt/seed as a pre-change render) that completes the CLIPSeg path and passes both gates.

notes.note:
ACCEPTED + CONTAINED; the planned graph repair is not implementable as specified, and closing it is a decision, not an auto-close.

ROOT CAUSE located in source, not inferred: custom_nodes/was-ns/WAS_Node_Suite.py:12454-12457 -- bounded_image_crop_with_mask computes rows/cols via torch.any then indexes torch.where(rows)[0][[0,-1]] with NO zero-area guard, so an all-zero mask indexes an empty tensor -> 'index is out of bounds for dimension with size 0'. The empty mask comes from the graph's ApplyCLIPSeg+ nodes (bounded crop in step 39/40 'Generate One Step': ApplyCLIPSeg+ prompt='head' threshold 0.4 -> GrowMaskWithBlur -> Bounded Image Crop with Mask, and prompt='hand' likewise) on a sample where CLIPSeg detects nothing at 0.4.

WHY THE PREVIOUS PLAN ('guard the crop node via a pipeline:prompt_safety-shaped rake edit') CANNOT WORK: the node returns BOTH a cropped IMAGE and IMAGE_BOUNDS, and the bounds are consumed by Bounded Image Blend (nodes 799 / 17 / 18). Any static edit that makes the mask non-empty -- lowering the threshold, OR-ing with a frame mask, growing the mask -- moves the crop and blend region on EVERY render, not only the failing one, i.e. it silently changes all output. An empty mask cannot be branched on in a static ComfyUI graph, and the only sound guard is an empty-mask fallback INSIDE the node -- whose file lives in the SHARED ComfyUI install (/mnt/fscache/essdee/ComfyUI), outside this repo and in live use by the operator's interactive session (pid 553489). Not ours to edit; recorded here as the option if the operator ever wants it, not filed as an ask.

DAMAGE IS BOUNDED AND ALREADY CONTAINED IN-REPO: DB histogram over comfyui_jobs: 260 'index is out of bounds' deaths all-time, of which 259 are 2025-12-10/11 (211+36) and 2026-05-26 (12) -- bursts from a superseded graph era -- and exactly ONE since the clean pipeline went live (job 7563, 2026-09-21 11:13Z). Growth::ContentGenerator#generate_one now RE-SUBMITS once on a node exception with a genuinely different sample (seed = pipeline_run.variables['seed'] + comfyui_job.id, SubmitJob#apply_job_variables), so a lost render is recovered inside the claim the tick already holds; the retry is bounded to one on purpose (a deterministic failure must fail the run, not loop).

TRACKER: the fresh-error reporter (24h window) is the right shape for a one-off node crash and now cannot be closed by a render drought (render_coverage_verdict: a zero-attempt window files UNVERIFIED instead), so a recurrence re-fires by itself with the newer error text.

VERIFICATION: node source read (WAS_Node_Suite.py:12440-12469); DB histogram query above; retry call path read at packs/growth_harness/app/services/growth/content_generator.rb:78-99; selftest 390 assertions / 0 failures.
